messages:
eva: Quick heads-up — I’m pausing non-critical deploys to prod-EU for the next ~2h. We saw a reproducible tail-latency spike in the embeddings path after yesterday's kernel roll. Suspect KV cache eviction behavior change.

raj: Ack. I’m pulling recent traces and will run a bisect against the runtime kernel changes.

lena: Reproduced locally with a 1.2x tail in p99 for long sequences. Spinning up a staging canary to rollback the quant-kernel build.

deploy-bot: Triggered rollback job #4823 -> rolling back runtime-image:release-v3.6.2 to v3.6.1 in eu-prod-stage. (reason: autosnoop detect: p99-latency anomaly) :gear:

devops: Shifting 15% of EU traffic to us-west to reduce impact. Updated routing policy in traffic-router. No config changes to customers.

sre-oncall: Adding a temporary rate cap on large-embedding routes (/embed/batch) and increasing alert sensitivity to +10% on tail.

eva: Action items: 1) No merges that change DB schemas or model artifacts until we clear this hold. 2) Eng-runtime to validate KV eviction heuristics against the rollback baseline. 3) Product and Release: hold feature gates that scheduled for tonight. 4) Ops: keep traffic shifts and rate caps in place until recovery.

raj: Quick note — I found a heap fragmentation pattern tied to the new kernel's page-splitting; running a patched kernel build now. If patch looks good we can patch-forward rather than rollback fully.

lena: Staging rollback finished, running perf harness. Initial numbers look back to baseline for p50/p95, p99 down ~18%. Posting harness logs soon.

deploy-bot: Perf harness report: p99 before=422ms, after-rollback=345ms, error-rate unchanged. Link: https://ci.internal/perf/4823

eva: Thanks. If staging numbers are stable for 30m, we’ll run a staged roll to prod with the rollback image at 10% -> 40% -> 100% with canary watch. Release train remains otherwise on schedule, this is an ad-hoc short hold not a freeze.

raj: I’ll keep bisecting and prep the kernel patch as an option.

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards updated, paging thresholds lowered for the next 3 hours. I’ll escalate if SLO drift continues.

devops: Noted — I’ll add a short note to the weekly deploy digest about the hold and traffic shift so PMs are aware.

eva: Reassess at +90m (thread update). If we clear, we’ll resume normal rolling cadence and lift merge constraints. :white_check_mark:

lena: Sending final staging log snippet: ```[perf] 2026-03-23T10:12:04Z p99=345ms kv_evictions=12 per_min```

raj: FYI: bisect points to commit `kernel/opt-2026-03-21` as probable. Will open a follow-up PR for the patch and tag runtime-team.

eva: Great. Please keep updates short here. Will post status at +90m or sooner if we need a release freeze. Thanks everyone. :pray:
